1|Israele, una promessa, una storia, fin.scena: Golden dawn light over Jerusalem's Old City seen from afar: the Dome of the Rock gleaming, church domes and pale limestone walls, ancient stones of the Western Wall, olive trees and soft mist in the valley below.

dom-2026-11-08.scena: An old brass telescope on a wooden table beside a closed leather-bound book, by an open Renaissance window overlooking Florence rooftops at dusk, Jupiter and the first stars glowing in a deep blue sky, warm candlelight.

dom-2026-11-15.scena: A quiet 1930s physicist's study at night: chalkboard swirls without writing, brass telescope by an open window, a vast spiral galaxy glowing in a deep starry sky, warm desk lamp light mingling with soft dawn rays on the horizon.

sab-2026-11-07.scena: An ancient stone well at dusk in a golden desert valley, ten camels resting nearby, a clay water jar on the rim, and in the distance a tent glowing with a single warm lamp beneath a soft cloud.

sab-2026-11-14.scena: A lit Hanukkah menorah with nine small oil flames on a wooden windowsill at night, the raised central lamp glowing, a small wooden spinning top and a plate of golden doughnuts nearby, snowy rooftops softly visible outside.

vetrina-prof.scena: A sunlit high school classroom at morning, empty wooden desks, a projector glowing softly, open notebooks and colorful folders on a teacher's desk, a window framing green hills and a distant bell tower, warm hopeful light.
